metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds a Rose bill read twice, a private note of two maids, and sixteen bars.

yesterday: The Rose title was A Toy to Please Chaste Ladies. You read it twice. The bill gave the title alone.
Under the Duke's wedding you wrote two maids in the wood, one little and one tall. The initials are N. S. and A. M. The line stops at the pair.
The feast is sixteen bars, then the viol down, then the fourteen lines. Nick stayed under the note. The count is in the margin.
You were Egeon at two. The lovers' parts are not copied out, and the two maids are one line.
